question: How many subtle channels are traditionally said to exist in the body?
premises: The count given is three crores and one thousand.
These are channels in the body.
They are considered to be so.
inference: The body is traditionally held to contain three crores and one thousand subtle channels.
uncertainties: The exact numerical expression tisraḥ koṭyaḥ sahasraṃ is unusual and may reflect textual convention.
plain_english: Indeed, three crores and one thousand channels are considered to be in the body.
